## TOEIC Part 1: Focus on Verbs 📸

En la Parte 1, concéntrate en:
1. **Sujeto** (Who)
2. **Acción** (Present Continuous)
3. **Entorno** (Where)
parts.audio: Welcome to the Listening Section. In Part 1, you will see a picture. I will read four sentences. You must select the one that best describes the action. Beware of similar sounding words!

questions.question: [IMAGE CONTEXT: A busy business setting]. Listen to the four statements.
questions.audio_script: A) They are scheduling an appointment in the airport terminal. B) They are watching a movie. C) He is leaving the airport terminal. D) The airport terminal is empty.
questions.explanation: La descripción correcta es: 'They are scheduling an appointment in the airport terminal.'.

questions.question: [IMAGE CONTEXT: A busy business setting]. Listen to the four statements.
questions.audio_script: A) The conference room is empty. B) They are eating lunch. C) They are boarding the flight in the conference room. D) He is leaving the conference room.
questions.explanation: La descripción correcta es: 'They are boarding the flight in the conference room.'.

questions.question: [IMAGE CONTEXT: A busy business setting]. Listen to the four statements.
questions.audio_script: A) They are reviewing the quarterly report in the airport terminal. B) The airport terminal is empty. C) They are cleaning the floor. D) He is leaving the airport terminal.
questions.explanation: La descripción correcta es: 'They are reviewing the quarterly report in the airport terminal.'.

questions.question: Listen to the conversation. Where does the woman want to go?
questions.audio_script:
W: Excuse me, does this bus go to the city center?
M: No, this one goes to the airport. You need the number 42 bus.
W: Oh, thanks. Do you know when it arrives?
questions.explanation: Basado en el audio, la fecha fue extendida hasta el Viernes.
